title: New York man killed after bag caught in subway train doors, police say
description:
Man, 57, was reportedly leaving A train at Utica Avenue station when stuck bag dragged him back and on to tracks

A man in Brooklyn, New York, died after his bag got caught between the doors of a subway train which then dragged him down.

On Monday, a man was leaving a Manhattan-bound A train at the Utica Avenue station in Brooklyn’s Bedford-Stuyvesant neighborhood when his shopping bag became caught between the subway’s doors.
